title: Null Acceptance
description: Distinguishes an optional parameter that may be omitted from a parameter that explicitly accepts null.
question: Does adaptation preserve whether each parameter accepts null?
notes: Four capture boundaries preserve the source nullability. CrewAI wraps optional fields in unions that newly accept null.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: optional fields are emitted through nullable anyOf wrappers, broadening the accepted values beyond omission alone.

verdict.headline: Preserved at four boundaries, broadened at one.
verdict.detail: CrewAI adds null acceptance to optional fields that the source schema does not declare nullable.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP tool schemas distinguishing omission from null.
known_issues: A server may reject explicit null even when omission is valid, creating avoidable validation failures.
why: Optional and nullable are different contracts. Conflating them lets a downstream caller express values the source never accepted.
reproduce: uv run mcp-mirror scan "uv run python fixtures/tricky_server.py" --runner managed --frameworks crewai,langchain,openai_agents,pydantic_ai --spec-version 2025-11-25 --job J2
